label: TP
reason: User input flows through getParameterNames() -> doSomething() -> bar variable, which is directly concatenated into XPath expression at line 79 without validation. Although XXE prevention is enabled via disallow-doctype-decl, the XPath expression still allows user-controlled strings in [@emplid=...] pattern enabling XPath injection.

evidence.note: user-param flows to XPath expression without sanitization
